theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_density_ge_one_ae
theorems.statement: ApproxTangentAE → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → IsOpen U → V.MultiplicityGE 1 U → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ U → V.HasDensityAt x (V.density x) ∧ 1 ≤ V.density x
